de: High prices for petroleum products can become a factor in accelerating inflation, which will lead to economic stagnation in countries.

de: In school pants for boys brands Crazy Beaver and Roberto Balzini found highly dangerous substances that can cause irritation, allergies, headache and toxic effects.

te: In the Stavropol region, a teenager on a pitbike hit a woman

te: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi denied the fact of Japanese espionage in Russia
